description: A key that opens the storage hold\ninside the ABANDONED SHIP.\nIt is old and looks easily broken.

name: ROOT FOSSIL
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a plant root.

name: CLAW FOSSIL
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a claw.

name: DEVON SCOPE
description: A scope that signals the presence\nof any unseeable POKéMON.\nIt is made by the DEVON CORP.

name: TM01
description: An extremely powerful attack.\nHowever, if the user is hit before\nusing the move, they will flinch.

name: TM02
description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash\nthe foe quickly and with great\npower.

name: TM03
description: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast\nof water. It may also confuse the\ntarget.

name: TM04
description: The user calms its spirit and\nfocuses its mind to raise its\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

name: TM05
description: A savage roar that causes the foe\nto switch out of battle. In the\nwild, ROAR ends the battle.

name: TM06
description: A move that leaves the foe badly\npoisoned. Its poison damage worsens\nevery turn.

name: TM07
description: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for\nfive turns. The hailstorm damages\nall types except the ICE type.

name: TM08
description: The user tightens all its muscles\nand bulks up, boosting both its\nATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

name: TM09
description: The user shoots seeds at the foe\nin rapid succession. Two to five\nseeds are shot at once.

name: TM10
description: A variable move that changes type\nand power depending on the POKéMON\nusing it.

name: TM11
description: The weather is turned sunny for\nfive turns. Over that time, FIRE-\ntype moves are powered up.

name: TM12
description: A taunted foe may become enraged.\nIt will then only be able to use\nattack moves.

name: TM13
description: An icy-cold beam is shot at the\nfoe. It may leave the target\nfrozen.

name: TM14
description: A vicious snow-and-wind attack that\nstrikes all foes in battle. It may\ncause freezing.

name: TM15
description: A harsh attack that inflicts severe\ndamage on the foe. However, the\nuser must rest the next turn.

name: TM16
description: A wall of light is created over\nfive turns. It reduces damage from\nSP. ATK attacks.

name: TM17
description: The user is completely protected\nfrom attack in the turn it is used.\nIt may fail if used in succession.

name: TM18
description: A heavy rain is summoned for five\nturns. Over that time, WATER-type\nmoves are powered up.

name: TM19
description: The user strikes the foe with\ntentacles or roots, stealing the\ntarget's HP and healing itself.

name: TM20
description: Protects the party with a shield\nagainst all status problems over\nfive turns.

name: TM21
description: This attack move grows more\npowerful the more the POKéMON\ndislikes its TRAINER.

name: TM22
description: A 2-turn attack that uses the first\nturn for absorbing sunlight, then\nblasting the foe in the next turn.

name: TM23
description: The foe is slammed with a sturdy\ntail of steel. It may lower the\ntarget's DEFENSE stat.

name: TM24
description: A massive jolt of electricity is\nlaunched at the foe. It may cause\nparalysis.

name: TM25
description: Strikes the foe with a huge\nthunderbolt. It may cause\nparalysis.

name: TM26
description: Causes an earthquake that strikes\nall POKéMON in battle, excluding\nthe user.

name: TM27
description: This attack move grows more\npowerful the more the POKéMON\nlikes its TRAINER.

name: TM28
description: A 2-turn attack in which the user\ndigs underground, then strikes.\nIt can be used to exit dungeons.

name: TM29
description: A powerful blast of telekinetic\nenergy strikes the foe. It may\nlower the target's SP. DEF stat.

name: TM30
description: The foe is attacked with a shadowy\nlump. It may lower the target's\nSP. DEF stat.

name: TM31
description: Strikes the foe with a rock-hard\nfist, etc. It shatters barriers such\nas REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN.

name: TM32
description: The user begins moving so quickly\nthat it creates illusory copies to\nraise its evasiveness.

name: TM33
description: A tough barrier is put up over five\nturns. It reduces damage from\nphysical attacks over that time.

name: TM34
description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes\nthe foe. This attack is impossible\nto evade.

name: TM35
description: The foe is roasted with a heavy\nblast of fire. It may leave the\ntarget with a burn.

name: TM36
description: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe\nwith great force. It may also\npoison the target.

name: TM37
description: Summons a sandstorm that lasts for\nfive turns. It damages all types\nexcept ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

name: TM38
description: The foe is incinerated with an\nintense flame. It may leave the\ntarget with a burn.

name: TM39
description: Boulders are hurled at the foe.\nIt also lowers the target's SPEED\nstat if it hits.

name: TM40
description: An extremely fast attack against\none target. It is impossible to\nevade.

name: TM41
description: If enraged by this move, the target\nbecomes incapable of using the same\nmove twice in a row.

name: TM42
description: An attack move that becomes very\npowerful if the user is poisoned,\nburned, or paralyzed.

name: TM43
description: An attack move that may have an\nadditional effect depending on the\nbattle terrain.

name: TM44
description: A move that makes the user fall\nasleep over two turns to restore HP\nand heal any status problems.

name: TM45
description: The foe, if it is the opposite\ngender as the user, becomes\ninfatuated and may not attack.

name: TM46
description: An attack that gives the user an\nopportunity to steal the foe's hold\nitem.

name: TM47
description: The foe is struck with steel-hard\nwings. It may also raise the user's\nDEFENSE stat.

name: TM48
description: A special power is transmitted to\nthe foe, causing it to switch\nabilities with the user.

name: TM49
description: A move that steals the effects of\nany status-changing or healing move\nthat the foe tries to use.

name: TM50
description: A maximum-power attack of great\nferocity, but one that also sharply\nreduces the user's SP. ATK stat.

name: HM01
description: Attacks the foe with sharp blades\nor claws. It can also cut down thin\ntrees and grass outside of battle.

name: HM02
description: The user flies up on the first turn,\nthen attacks next turn. It can be\nused to fly to any known town.

name: HM03
description: Creates a huge wave, then crashes\nit down on the foe. It can be used\nfor traveling on water.

name: HM04
description: The user builds enormous power,\nthen slams the foe. It can be used\nfor moving large, round boulders.

name: HM05
description: Looses a powerful blast of light\nthat reduces the foe's accuracy.\nIt also lights up dark caves.

name: HM06
description: Hits the foe with a rock-crushingly\ntough attack. It can smash cracked\nboulders.

name: HM07
description: A powerful charge attack. It can\nbe used for climbing a torrential\nwaterfall.

name: HM08
description: A 2-turn attack in which the user\ndives underwater on the first turn,\nthen strikes in the next turn.

name: OAK'S PARCEL
description: A parcel to be delivered to PROF.\nOAK from VIRIDIAN CITY's POKéMON\nMART.

name: POKé FLUTE
description: A flute that is said to instantly\nawaken any POKéMON. It has a\nlovely tone.

name: SECRET KEY
description: The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM's\nfront door. It is colored red and\ndecorated.

name: BIKE VOUCHER
description: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP\nin CERULEAN CITY and exchange it\nfor a bicycle.

name: GOLD TEETH
description: A set of false teeth lost by the\nSAFARI ZONE'S WARDEN. It makes his\nsmile sparkle.

name: OLD AMBER
description: A piece of amber that contains\nthe genes of an ancient POKéMON.\nIt is clear with a reddish tint.

name: CARD KEY
description: A card-type key that unlocks doors\nin SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE in\nSAFFRON CITY.

name: LIFT KEY
description: A key that operates the elevator\nin TEAM ROCKET's HIDEOUT.\nIt bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.

name: HELIX FOSSIL
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a seashell.

name: DOME FOSSIL
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a shell.

name: SILPH SCOPE
description: A scope that makes unseeable\nPOKéMON visible.\nIt is made by SILPH CO.

name: BICYCLE
description: A folding bicycle that allows\nfaster movement than the RUNNING\nSHOES.

name: TOWN MAP
description: A very convenient map that can be\nviewed anytime. It even shows your \npresent location.

name: VS SEEKER
description: A device that indicates TRAINERS\nwho want to battle. The battery\ncharges while traveling.

name: FAME CHECKER
description: A device that enables you to\nrecall what you've heard and seen\nabout famous people.

name: TM CASE
description: A case that holds TMs and HMs.\nIt is attached to the BAG's\ncompartment for important items.

name: BERRY POUCH
description: A pouch for carrying BERRIES.\nIt is attached to the BAG's\ncompartment for important items.

name: TEACHY TV
description: A television set that is tuned to\na program with useful tips for\nnovice TRAINERS.

name: TRI-PASS
description: A pass for ferries between ONE,\nTWO, and THREE ISLAND.\nIt has a drawing of three islands.

name: RAINBOW PASS
description: A pass for ferries between\nVERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS.\nIt features a drawing of a rainbow.

name: TEA
description: An aromatic tea prepared by an old\nlady. It will slake even the worst\nthirst.

name: MYSTICTICKET
description: A ticket required to board the ship\nto NAVEL ROCK.\nIt glows with a mystic light.

name: AURORATICKET
description: A ticket required to board the ship\nto BIRTH ISLAND.\nIt glows beautifully.

name: POWDER JAR
description: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER\nmade using a BERRY CRUSHER.

name: RUBY
description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that\nhas a red glow.\nIt symbolizes passion.

name: SAPPHIRE
description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that\nhas a blue glow.\nIt symbolizes honesty.
